title: The solar system
subtitle: The Sun, the planets, and the moons and dwarf planets worth knowing
description: Each world as a whole disc, then up close at its surface.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.subtitle: Our star
cards.summary: A middle-aged yellow dwarf star holding 99.8% of the solar system's mass.

cues.overall: Glowing disc; dark sunspots come and go
cues.surface: Granules of boiling plasma and loops of flare

cards.name: Mercury
cards.subtitle: 1st planet
cards.summary: The smallest planet and closest to the Sun: a cratered, airless ball.
facts: A bit larger than our Moon

cues.overall: Gray-brown and cratered, like the Moon

cards.name: Venus
cards.subtitle: 2nd planet
cards.summary: Earth's twin in size, wrapped in sulfuric clouds; the hottest planet.

cues.surface: Radar maps of lava plains and volcanoes

cards.name: Earth
cards.subtitle: 3rd planet
cards.summary: The only world known to have life and liquid surface water.

cues.overall: Blue oceans, white swirling clouds, brown-green land
cues.surface: Coasts, clouds and city lights from orbit

cards.name: The Moon
cards.subtitle: Earth's moon
cards.summary: Always shows Earth the same face, with dark lava 'seas' and bright highlands.

cues.overall: Dark maria form the 'Man in the Moon'

cards.name: Mars
cards.subtitle: 4th planet
cards.summary: The red planet: rusty dust, polar ice caps and the tallest volcano known.

cues.overall: Rust-orange with dark patches and white polar caps
cues.surface: Red rocky desert seen by rovers

cards.name: Ceres
cards.subtitle: Dwarf planet
cards.summary: The largest object in the asteroid belt, with bright salt spots.

cues.overall: Gray, cratered sphere with bright white spots

cards.name: Jupiter
cards.subtitle: 5th planet
cards.summary: The biggest planet: a striped gas giant with the Great Red Spot storm.

cues.overall: Cream and brown cloud bands with a red oval spot
cues.surface: Swirling storms and turbulent cloud belts

cards.name: Io
cards.subtitle: Moon of Jupiter
cards.summary: The most volcanic world known, splotched yellow with sulfur.

cues.overall: Pizza-like: yellow, orange and black blotches

cards.name: Europa
cards.subtitle: Moon of Jupiter
cards.summary: An icy shell over a hidden salty ocean; a top place to look for life.
facts: Twice Earth's water, under the ice
A bit smaller than our Moon

cues.overall: White-tan ball crossed by reddish streaks

cards.name: Ganymede
cards.subtitle: Moon of Jupiter
cards.summary: The largest moon in the solar system, bigger than Mercury.
facts: The only moon with its own

cues.overall: Patchwork of dark and light grooved terrain
cues.surface: Bright grooves cutting dark ancient crust

cards.name: Saturn
cards.subtitle: 6th planet
cards.summary: The ringed planet; so light it would float in a big enough bathtub.

cues.overall: Butterscotch globe circled by bright rings
cues.surface: Ring details and a hexagon storm at the pole

cards.name: Titan
cards.subtitle: Moon of Saturn
cards.summary: A moon with a thick orange haze, and lakes and rain of liquid methane.

cues.overall: Fuzzy orange ball with no visible surface
cues.surface: Hazy view of pebbles and dark plains from Huygens

cards.name: Enceladus
cards.subtitle: Moon of Saturn
cards.summary: A small, bright-white moon spraying geysers of water from its south pole.

cues.overall: Snow-white sphere with blue 'tiger stripe' cracks
cues.surface: Plumes of ice spraying into space

cards.name: Uranus
cards.subtitle: 7th planet
cards.summary: An ice giant tipped on its side, pale blue-green from methane.

cues.surface: Faint rings and bands in infrared

cards.name: Neptune
cards.subtitle: 8th planet
cards.summary: The farthest planet: deep blue, with the fastest winds in the solar system.

cues.overall: Deep blue with white streaky clouds
cues.surface: Dark storm spots and high bright clouds

cards.name: Triton
cards.subtitle: Moon of Neptune
cards.summary: A captured moon that orbits backwards, with nitrogen geysers.

cues.overall: Pinkish south cap over a 'cantaloupe' terrain
cues.surface: Dimpled terrain and dark geyser streaks

cards.name: Pluto
cards.subtitle: Dwarf planet
cards.summary: A dwarf planet in the Kuiper belt with a heart-shaped nitrogen-ice plain.

cues.overall: Tan and orange with a big pale heart
cues.surface: Ice mountains beside the smooth heart plain
